name: Manifestation of the Dying of the Light Ritual

system.description: You hasten an end to the world's suffering, vomiting black bile into a sacred vessel and casting it to the winds.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and you choose which Misery.
outcomes.failure: The ritual fails, but the bile remains, and so does the will to use it.
outcomes.ruin: A Misery is triggered, and it begins where you stand. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
